page_title: PSG 1-0 ANG | PSG v Angers 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Marc Bollengier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Nuno Mendes (PSG) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
90+2' Great save! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Yahia Fofana.
90+1' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) works the corner short.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Senny Mayulu (PSG) on for Warren Zaire-Emery.
86' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) plays a one-two with Joao Neves, but the move breaks down.
82' It looked like the long-range shot by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
81' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner with a short pass.
81' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Ibrahima Niane (Angers) replaces Esteban Lepaul.
80' The substitution is prepared. Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yassine Belkhdim.

80' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Yahia Fofana is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
79' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
79' Jordan Lefort (Angers) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Angers have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Bradley Barcola (PSG) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
73' 16:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:0.
71' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Jacques Ekomie is replaced by Bamba Dieng (Angers).
71' Substitution. Jean-Eudes Aholou is replaced by Zinedine Ould Khaled (Angers).
70' One of the Angers players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to PSG.
68' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
67' Joao Neves (PSG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Desire Doue.
67' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. PSG are taking a throw-in.
66' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off the line to clear the ball away.
64' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.
63' Goncalo Ramos goes off the pitch and Ousmane Dembele (PSG) comes on.
63' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Willian Pacho and he is replaced by Nuno Mendes (PSG).
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fabian Ruiz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Bradley Barcola (PSG).
62' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

60' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Yahia Fofana, who makes a glorious save!
59' A free kick into the box, taken by Vitinha (PSG), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.

58' Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marc Bollengier blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. PSG win a free kick.

55' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Desire Doue (PSG) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the roof of the net. The assist goes to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and the score changes to 1:0.
55' Jim Allevinah (Angers) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

54' Desire Doue (PSG) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
53' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Esteban Lepaul (Angers) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
50' Desire Doue (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' The ball is cleared after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' CHANCE! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
46' Alexandre Dujeux makes a switch. Jim Allevinah is coming on in place of Farid El Melali (Angers) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Desire Doue (PSG) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Yahia Fofana makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
42' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
41' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
41' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
35' A dangerous looking corner kick from Desire Doue (PSG) is cleared to safety by the defence.

35' That was a nice football moment. Vitinha (PSG) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top left corner. Yahia Fofana guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

34' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort. A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Vitinha (PSG). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
33' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) touches the ball with his hand. PSG earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
31' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.

30' Farid El Melali (Angers) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
30' The total number of attempts is 3:0.
26' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
25' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) and Fabian Ruiz attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
22' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
21' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
21' Referee Marc Bollengier sees the trip by Jacques Ekomie (Angers) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PSG are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
16' Marc Bollengier blows the whistle, Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is penalised for a foul.
15' Florent Hanin (Angers) picks up a yellow card.
14' Florent Hanin (Angers) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marc Bollengier signals. It's a free kick to PSG, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
8' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
7' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
6' Desire Doue (PSG) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
5' Half-chance! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana reacts well to snuff out the attack.
3' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
2' Some great controlled play and passing from PSG. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
